summary: Added DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py) for Databricks connections using OAuth client credentials: login maps to client_id, password to client_secret (stored as env var COSMOS_CONN_DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET), and the profile sets auth_type: oauth. It declines connections with extra.token so they stay with the token mapping. Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and registered it before DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings. Added tests in tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py. Tests were not run, per instructions. Docs and CHANGELOG were not updated. Nothing committed.
